title: Remove Letter To Equalize Frequency
summary: Given a string consisting of lowercase English letters, determine if removing one letter can make the frequency of each letter equal.
statement: Given a string consisting of lowercase English letters, determine if removing one letter can make the frequency of each letter equal. Return true if possible, otherwise false. The frequency of a letter is its count in the string, and exactly one letter must be removed.
constraints: Remove exactly one occurrence from the lowercase string.
After removal, every remaining distinct letter must have the same positive frequency.
reference_solution:
def can_equalize_frequency_by_removal(word):
    from collections import Counter
    counts=Counter(word)
    for char in list(counts):
        counts[char]-=1
        remaining=[value for value in counts.values() if value]
        if len(set(remaining))<=1:return True
        counts[char]+=1
    return False
